verdicts.evidence: lines 754-770 wire every static button; dynamic ones have handlers: Try again (536, 713 as type=submit in the form), Choose (573), Switch to (630). Back and Change room call history.back, handled by popstate at 419-425.
lines 511-521 and 563-583: rooms, count and features come from api.findRooms; 719-733 the done view is built from the createBooking response. No hardcoded records or placeholder text.
lines 601-609: the details step shows Room, Where, Date, Time and People in a summary card above the form; results head repeats the criteria (580).

State lives only in the in-memory object at line 394 and in DOM fields; no sessionStorage, localStorage or URL state. Back and server errors keep values, but a reload returns to step 1 with room, title and note gone (750-752).

lines 434-441 default to today or next slot, 212 one hour, 221 two people; catering checkbox unticked (261). Enter submits the form's own search or confirm, with the summary in view; nothing destructive is preselected.
Search and results share one screen (195-232); choosing a room goes straight to details then confirm (594-599, 672-699). No dialogs or extra screens beyond the steps the brief names.
Sections are step indicator, search form, free rooms, details form with catering and note, and booked summary (181-301). Each maps to a brief task; no stat cards, feeds or tips.

line 573: every room's Choose button uses the filled primary class 'btn', alongside the filled search button (226); the exception requires row actions to be secondary. Line 713 adds a filled Try again in the same form as filled Confirm booking (279).
No action deletes, overwrites or is irreversible in the rule's sense; Book another room (736-742) only starts a new flow after the booking is saved.
lines 621-627: catering checkbox is disabled only when the room lacks catering, with the reason in text beside it (catering-help). Other disabling is only during the confirm request (660-669).
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
All visible strings (179-299, 464-470, 539-557, 708-713) concern booking; nothing mentions implementation, mock data or the request.

line 238 'Nothing is booked until you confirm.' informs the confirm decision but sits under the page heading, a card and three fields away from the button (279). First read passed it, second read failed it on placement.
line 193: 'Tell us when you need it and we will show the rooms that are free.' narrates what the form below does rather than being guidance at a control.

line 721: the lead under 'Room booked' states room, date and time, which the Booking details list directly below repeats (724-727). Lines 551-552 also restate 'No rooms are free' as 'Nothing is free on ...'.
Headings are 'Book a meeting room', 'Meeting details', 'Room booked' (192, 237, 290); no greetings, slogans, superlatives or exclamation marks in any string.
line 573: with several rooms in view each button's visible label is just 'Choose'; the room name is only in aria-label. Other labels are specific (226, 279, 299, 630).
line 388 maps feature keys to words; 729 shows 'Requested' or 'Not requested'; error codes are translated (525-527, 703-713). The only id shown is labelled 'Booking reference' (732).
lines 539-541 and 711-713 name the problem (booking system did not respond, nothing saved) and offer Try again; field errors give the fix (464-470, 676). The raw ECONNRESET message is never shown.
Error strings at 464-470, 527, 539-540, 676, 708-712 contain no 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals; the subject is the problem.
lines 548-561: zero rooms shows 'No rooms are free', the searched criteria, and next steps (different time, shorter meeting, another day, fewer people) pointing at the search form directly above.
No match renders the neutral notice with suggestions to change the search (549-558); a failed load renders a separate problem notice with Try again (535-544).
Search failure: one silent retry (514) then an in-place notice with Try again, form untouched (535-544). Booking failure: notice at top of the form with Try again, fields kept (711-713).
lines 476-481 and 502-508: spinner and 'Finding rooms...' on the button plus status line and skeletons at once; 666 shows 'Booking...'. Calls take at most about 3 seconds including the retry.
lines 502-507 show the status line and skeletons while waiting; the empty notice and count are rendered only in renderRooms after the response (519-521, 548).
overflow-wrap:anywhere on h1, h3 and summary dd (56, 58, 159); .info min-width:0 with a non-shrinking button (136, 141); empty features omit the tag list (572); a missing note omits its row (731).

The details step holds a title and note saved only by Confirm booking. In-app Back keeps them, but there is no beforeunload handler or stored draft, so closing the tab discards them with no prompt (wiring 750-770).
line 255: title has maxlength=80 with no stated limit, unlike the note's counter (274). The date must be today or later, but that rule appears only as an error after submit (465).
lines 263 and 271 mark catering and note '(optional)' in words; the title is unmarked and carries required (255). The search fields are all required.
Validation runs only on submit (457-474, 674-679); input and change handlers only clear errors (755-766). No error is raised while typing.
lines 200, 205, 222, 256 place an error paragraph under each field; setError fills it with text and sets aria-invalid, which thickens the border (94, 444-455).
No code clears fields on rejection: readCriteria and confirmBooking only set errors (457-474, 700-715). The untick at 707 is unreachable because catering is disabled for rooms without it (621, 683).

line 472 focuses the first invalid search field; 448-449 set aria-invalid and aria-describedby; the title references title-error (255) and is focused (677). Server failures focus the alert block (657).
Submit buttons are never disabled before completion; aria-disabled is set only during their own request (478, 664). Submitting with missing input shows the field message (470, 676).
line 673 returns if already submitting and 495 returns while the search button is busy; both buttons show a spinner and busy label (480, 666).
Search and confirm switch to a busy label synchronously before the await (500, 688); Choose, Switch, Back and Book another change the view at once (598, 634-641, 741).
Success shows the Room booked view with details (696-698); search shows the count and list (576-583); every failure renders a message (535-544, 703-713).
The only success message is the Room booked view (287-297), which is the sole place the saved booking is visible; there is no extra toast. The live region text at 699 is screen-reader only.
Errors render in place (535-544, 649-658) with no timers; they are removed only on retry, a changed search or a corrected field (646-647, 760, 766).
No action removes, archives or moves a stored item; the flow only creates a booking.
Nothing permanently deletes or overwrites data, sends an unrecallable message or spends money; the booking is confirmed on a review step with a summary (240-246, 279).
No confirmation dialogs: no confirm(), dialog element or modal in the file.
No optimistic updates; the done view is shown only after createBooking resolves (691-698).
No modal dialogs in the markup or script.
No modal dialogs in the markup or script.
Step 1 opens on the heading and search form with results beneath (192-232); only a small app name and step list sit above (179-186). Step 2 leads with the room summary then the form.
No hero, greeting or intro panel; the header is a small app name and step list (178-187), then the h1 and the form.
The only summary number is the count of free rooms as the results heading (576-579), which tells the user how many options there are to pick from.

line 580 shows the criteria and sort as text under a count heading (576), but there is no clear control; criteria are all required and editing one drops the results (760). First read passed, second read failed on the missing clear control.
All controls are native inputs, selects, a textarea and buttons (199-299, 573, 630); forms submit on Enter (754, 765); focus is moved to headings or errors, never trapped (413, 472, 543).
Errors carry text (95, 447); the current step has aria-current and bold weight (72, 410); the closest fit tag is text (566); disabled catering is explained in words (624-627).

line 304: a role=status live region exists on load and announce() fills it for loading, counts, empty and booked (399, 508, 559, 583, 699). Errors use role=alert and also take focus (538, 543, 652, 657).
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, comboboxes or tabs; the room switch list is shown by state, not by a toggle (613-632).
Viewport meta (5); grid drops to one column at 380px (81-82); room cards stack under 520px (142-144); buttons go full width under 480px (116); summary stacks under 420px (160-163); steps wrap (66).
